map.滚动轴承额定寿命L10估算 使用指南: Rolling bearing rated life L10 estimation user guide
map.输入轴承类型、转速、动载荷与当量动载荷，基于ISO 281计算轴承的基本额定寿命: Input bearing type, speed, dynamic load and equivalent dynamic load; based on ISO 281 compute bearing basic rated life L10 and modified rated life, predicting replacement interval.
map.基于 ISO 281 标准计算轴承基本额定寿命与修正额定寿命: Compute bearing basic rated life and modified rated life based on ISO 281
map.给定目标寿命 Lh、转速 n、尺寸 d·B，反求所需额定动载荷 C。: Given target life Lh, speed n, size d*B, solve inversely for the required rated dynamic load C.
map.校核平均压强 p=F/(d·B) 与 pV 值。: Check average pressure p=F/(d*B) and pV value.
map.比较不同寿命要求下的 C。: Compare C under different life requirements.
map.：F=5 kN、d=40 mm、B/d=0.4→B=16 mm、n=1500 r: : F=5 kN, d=40 mm, B/d=0.4 -> B=16 mm, n=1500 rpm, target Lh=20000 h: L10=Lh*60*n/1e6=20000x60x1500/1e6=1800 million revolutions; ball bearing C=F*L10^(1/3)=5000x1800^0.333=5000x12.16 approx 60800 N approx 60.8 kN. Average pressure p=5000/(40x16)=7.81 MPa.
map.球轴承寿命指数 p=3，C/P=(L10)^(1/3)；滚子轴承 p=10/3。: Ball bearing life exponent p=3, C/P=(L10)^(1/3); roller bearing p=10/3. This example uses ball bearing.
map.p=F/(d·B) 是投影比压，滑动轴承还需乘速度得 pV 控制发热。: p=F/(d*B) is the projected pressure; sliding bearings also multiply by speed to get pV for heat control.
